info.title: Admins API
info.description: API for managing your account — updating the details on record for a user you have booked. Every call must include a valid `ls-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: ls-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued by LabStack. Pass this in every request header. Your store can hold two active keys at once, so you can move to a new key before the old one is revoked. A key may have an expiry date; a request made with an expired or revoked key is refused as unauthorized.

error.example: Authorisation failed - API Key not present in HTTP Header.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — API key missing, invalid, expired or revoked

TooManyRequests.description: Too many failed authentication attempts from your address. Every request from that address is refused, whatever key it carries, until the number of seconds in the Retry-After header has passed.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — missing or invalid parameters

post.summary: Update a user's gender and date of birth

name.description: The user's name as on record. This call does not change it.

400.description: uniqueId is missing, none of gender, dateOfBirth or age is given, or a value given is invalid

404.description: No user with this uniqueId on your account

uniqueId.description: The user's unique id, as used when booking.

gender.description: At least one of gender, dateOfBirth or age is required.

dateOfBirth.description: At least one of gender, dateOfBirth or age is required. Cannot be in the future. Used instead of age when both are given.

age.description: At least one of gender, dateOfBirth or age is required. Whole years.

post.description:
Updates the gender and/or date of birth on record for an existing user, identified by the uniqueId they were booked with. uniqueId is required, and so is at least one of gender, dateOfBirth or age; when both dateOfBirth and age are given, dateOfBirth is used.
Only what you send is changed: a gender or date of birth you leave out stays as it is on record, and other user details are not changed. **Bookings and orders already placed for the user are not updated: one still in progress keeps the gender and date of birth it was placed with.**
The response returns the user's name, gender, date of birth and age as now on record; a gender, date of birth or age with nothing on record is null.
